claude_proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeaturePassiveMechanics
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Slippery Mind grants proficiency in Wisdom and Charisma saving throws permanently upon reaching level 15. It is never activated, consumes no resource, and has no reset cadence. The only existing class feature family is 'activation', which requires activationCost / resource / resetCadence / effect — none of which apply honestly to a permanently-granted passive trait. A new family (e.g. 'passive') is needed, with its own mechanics header that omits activation bookkeeping.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain proficiency in Wisdom and Charisma saving throws.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: GrantProficiencyEffect
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The grant_proficiency atom exists in v4 taxonomy (§9 Effect Atoms) but is absent from ClassFeatureEffect, which only has GrantExtraActionEffect | HealHpEffect. Slippery Mind's mechanic is purely a proficiency grant on two saving throws (Wisdom, Charisma). A new ClassFeatureEffect variant is needed to carry this — e.g. { kind: 'grant_proficiency', proficiencyKind: 'saving_throw', abilities: ReadonlyArray<Ability> }.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain proficiency in Wisdom and Charisma saving throws.
